answer: Histories are stored in lagoon, checked in anchor, and cedar publishes each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 7 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 1068 identities would post 4909 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
